title: API research spike
context: A timeboxed discovery sprint must prove that an external API can support one valuable user workflow on acceptable technical and business terms.

stories.title: Define the minimum API capability
stories.outcome: Research is constrained by a concrete user decision or task.
stories.context: Start from the selected milestone 0 idea. Write the smallest useful workflow and the exact data/capability it requires.
acceptanceCriteria: One user, problem, trigger, decision, and success measure are stated
Required and optional data fields are separated
Freshness, geography, volume, latency, and cost constraints are explicit

expectations.security: Classify requested data and authentication risk.
expectations.privacy: Avoid personal data unless necessary and justified.

definitionOfDone: Research question is answerable in the timebox

stories.title: Compare three API candidates
stories.outcome: The provider decision accounts for reliability, rights, cost, and failure rather than documentation aesthetics.
stories.context: Use official docs and live sandbox requests. Record auth, pricing, rate limits, pagination, freshness, terms, SDK health, Vercel compatibility, and support.
acceptanceCriteria: At least three candidates have linked primary documentation
One redacted success request and response is captured per viable candidate
401, 404, 429, timeout, and provider outage behaviors are investigated or documented
Each option has rejection risk and exit cost

expectations.security: Keys stay in local ignored files; logs and captures are redacted.
expectations.privacy: Terms and data rights are recorded.
expectations.accessibility: Provider does not determine UI accessibility.

nonGoals: Choosing solely because AI generated an SDK example

stories.title: Diagnose authentication and rate-limit failures
stories.outcome: Common API failures are understood before production implementation.
stories.context: Use safe test requests or supplied fixtures to reproduce a 401 and 429. Do not solve them by exposing a key in browser code or disabling limits.
acceptanceCriteria: The 401 cause is distinguished from authorization and missing-resource failures
Rate-limit headers and retry guidance are recorded
Proposed UI behavior avoids infinite retries and gives a useful next action

expectations.security: Credentials never appear in command history shared as evidence.

definitionOfDone: Root cause and safe response are explained
stories.seededBug: Use a deliberately wrong placeholder credential and a recorded 429 fixture; never use a real leaked key.

stories.title: Approve API architecture decision
stories.outcome: Milestone 6 has a chosen provider, normalized contract, and fallback.
stories.context: Summarize the evidence and choose, reject, or stop the idea. A stop decision is valid when no provider meets the constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR states decision, evidence, consequences, cost trigger, and exit plan
Normalized internal data shape is provider-independent
Cache/freshness and error strategy are defined
The next milestone scope fits sixteen hours

expectations.accessibility: All provider states map to user-facing states.
